This '''male [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomirian]]''' was the husband of [[Kirana Ti]] and father to their [[Kirana Ti's daughter|daughter]]. When Kirana went to train at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] he and their daughter were left behind but may have later reunited when Kirana returned to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
